Case: dev-saas-figma-2022

- Figma, Inc. is summarized from 3 cutoff-visible public evidence records dated on or before 2022-09-14.
- The normalized claim list contains 9 cited observations from source classes: company-primary, news.
- FigJam was described as supporting sticky notes, drawing tools, shapes, connectors, stamps, cursor chats and audio collaboration.
- Figma announced it closed a Series E financing round on 2021-06-24.

- Figma introduced FigJam on 2021-04-21 as an online whiteboard for teams.

  - Figma said the Series E was led by Durable Capital Partners. (value=Durable Capital Partners; period=instant 2021-06-24)
- Figma raises USD 200 million at USD 10 billion valuation [ev-aeeecbc6a15d]
